paragraphs.text: The Grimoire of the Dead is a legendary artifact on the plane of Innistrad .

The Grimoire of the Dead is a legendary, powerful grimoire on necromancy . It has a brown cover with the outline of a hand on top of it. The binding appears to have bones on the outside. Studying the grimoire allows one to gain the ability to reanimate the dead as zombies . This is represented in-game via study counters that are gained when the player discards a card. It can then be sacrificed to bring back all creatures from all graveyards to the battlefield under the user's control as black zombies once enough studying - gaining three study counters - is done.
